entities.summary: Song Seung-hyun (b. 1992-08-21, Seoul) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Seoul and South Korea. Known in the fields of south korea, composers & musicians, asia.
